# Easner

> Easner is stablecoin-native banking and payment infrastructure for individuals and businesses. Manage everyday finances, hold multiple currencies, receive payments, and pay people and businesses in the US and around the world. Settlement runs on stablecoin rails behind banking-simple screens. Banking and payment services are provided by licensed partners. Easner is not a bank.

## What Easner is

Easner has two core products: Easner Personal Banking and Easner Business Banking. Personal Banking covers accounts, cards, and sending and receiving money. Business Banking brings accounts, payment collections, cards, and payouts together, including Invoicing, Checkout, Payment Links, and Payroll. Partners and developers can build with Easner through branded programs and APIs. Dedicated pages explain each capability.

## Who Easner is for

- **Personal customers:** People managing everyday finances, receiving payments, and sending money to people and businesses, at home in the US and around the world.
- **Business customers:** US startups, small businesses, and established companies, as well as businesses operating globally. Easner brings accounts, customer payments, invoicing, team payments, and reporting into one dashboard.
- **Partners and developers:** Companies building branded financial products or embedding accounts and payments through Easner's infrastructure and APIs.

Easner accepts personal and business signups from most countries worldwide. Account and product availability depend on verification, jurisdiction, approval, and partner rules. The KYC/KYB and AML Policy lists restricted jurisdictions.

## Products

- [Download Easner](https://www.easner.com/app): Get the iOS or Android app. Mobile visitors are directed to the relevant app store; desktop visitors can scan a QR code or request a download link.
- [Personal Banking](https://www.easner.com/personal): Everyday money management, multiple currencies, receiving payments, and sending money through the Easner app. Web access is also available on desktop.
- [Business Banking](https://www.easner.com/business): Accounts, customer payments, supplier and team payments, invoices, and financial records in one dashboard.
- [Checkout](https://www.easner.com/checkout): Accept one-time and subscription payments on your website, connected to Easner Business.
- [Payment Links](https://www.easner.com/payment-links): Share a payment link to get paid without a website or code, for one-time or recurring payments.
- [Payroll](https://www.easner.com/payroll): Pay contractors and employees with approval workflows, pay stubs, and payment records.
- [Stablecoin Payments](https://www.easner.com/stablecoin): Send and receive supported stablecoins with asset, network, and payment details in one place.
- [Invoicing](https://www.easner.com/invoicing): Create invoices and let customers pay online, by bank transfer, or with supported stablecoins.
- [Cards](https://www.easner.com/cards): Personal and business cards with spending controls. Rolling out in phases, subject to availability and approval.
- [Partners](https://www.easner.com/partners): Branded payment programs through the Agency Model, with infrastructure and operational support.
- [Developers](https://www.easner.com/developers): APIs for verification, accounts, collections, payouts, and webhooks. Sandbox access and API reference are provided during commercial onboarding.

## Global payments

Easner connects US, EU, and UK payment infrastructure with more than 80 payout destinations worldwide. Account balances are held in USD, EUR, GBP, and NGN. Payment methods and currencies vary by account and destination. Payout coverage and account-opening eligibility are distinct; check the product information and KYC/KYB and AML Policy for details.

- **North America (US):** Personal and business accounts, USD balances, domestic and international payments, and cards.
- **Europe (EU, UK):** EUR and GBP balances, business collections, invoicing, and EURC settlement.
- **Africa:** Local payout connectivity including Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, Egypt, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Senegal, and Zambia.
- **Latin America:** Payouts including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Guatemala, Ecuador, and Jamaica.
- **Asia-Pacific and South Asia:** Payouts including India, China, the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, and Hong Kong.
- **Middle East:** Payouts including the United Arab Emirates and Israel.

## How Easner moves money

Easner settles cross-border payments on stablecoin rails, primarily USDC and EURC, then pays out in local currency at the destination. A customer sends dollars and the recipient is paid in their own currency; the settlement step happens in between and customers never handle it. A crypto wallet is not required to use Easner accounts, invoicing, Checkout, Payment Links, or Payroll. Timing depends on destination, payment method, banking hours, and verification checks.

## Frequently asked

- **Can I use Easner for everyday finances in the US?** Yes. Easner serves personal and business customers in the US. Manage balances, receive payments, and pay people and businesses, with international capabilities when you need them.
- **Does Easner offer personal and business accounts?** Yes. Easner Personal Banking is for individual finances; Easner Business Banking includes company accounts, payments, invoicing, payroll, and team access.
- **Is Easner a bank?** No. Easner is a financial technology company. Banking and payment services are provided by licensed partners.
- **Do I need to understand crypto to use Easner?** No. Customers see balances, payments, and recipients, the same as any banking app. There are no wallets or networks to manage. Stablecoin settlement runs behind the scenes.
- **What fees apply?** Applicable fees and exchange rates are shown before transfer confirmation. Timing depends on the payment method, destination, banking hours, and verification or partner checks.

### Personal Banking

- **How do I open an Easner Personal Banking account?** Download the Easner app on iPhone or Android, sign up with your email, and verify your identity. Once you're verified, your account details are ready to share.
- **Which currencies can I hold?** USD and EUR, and GBP where supported for your profile. Each balance gets account details in your name, so you can get paid directly.
- **How do I add money to my account?** Top up by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or ACH, or receive a bank transfer to your account details. Stablecoin deposits are also supported where enabled.
- **Where can I send money?** To bank accounts and mobile money in 80+ countries, and to other Easner users by EASETAG. You see the fee, the rate and what your recipient gets before you confirm.
- **How long does a transfer take?** Typically minutes to hours, same-day where supported. Every transfer shows its status in the app until it's completed.
- **How is my account protected?** An authenticator, your PIN and Face ID protect every sign-in and every new recipient, and a first payment to someone new can be held for your review. Easner verifies every customer and screens transactions; banking services are provided by licensed partners.

### Business Banking

- **Who can open an Easner Business account?** Startups, small businesses and established companies from most countries. A small number of jurisdictions are excluded for compliance and sanctions reasons.
- **What do I need to verify my business?** Your business registration details, the people who own and control it, and identity verification for each owner. You can track every step from your dashboard.
- **Which currencies can my business hold?** USD and EUR account details in your business's name, plus GBP and other currencies where supported for your organisation. Stablecoin deposits land in the same place where enabled.
- **How do I pay suppliers and contractors abroad?** Send from your balance to bank accounts, mobile money or stablecoin wallets in 80+ countries. The rate and fees are shown before you confirm, and each payment carries its own status.
- **Can my team use the account?** Yes. Invite teammates and give each one the access they need, with payment history and reports for the whole team.
- **How do customers pay my business?** Send an invoice, share a payment link, embed Checkout on your website, or collect in person with Terminal and QR Pay. Every payment lands in the same Easner Business ledger.

### Checkout

- **Can customers pay with stablecoins?** Yes, where enabled. A stablecoin option sits beside card and bank, and the payment lands in Easner Business like any other.
- **Can I charge subscriptions?** Yes. Set a billing interval and an optional free trial; customers see when they'll be charged before they pay.

### Payment Links

- **How can customers pay a link?** By card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, by US bank account, or with stablecoins where enabled.
- **Can I limit or close a link?** Yes. Cap the number of payments, let customers choose a quantity, or close the link whenever you're done.

### Invoicing

- **How can customers pay an invoice?** By card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, by bank transfer, or with stablecoins where enabled – all from the same hosted invoice page.
- **How are bank transfers matched to invoices?** Each invoice has its own reference. When a customer pays with it, the payment is matched to the invoice automatically.
- **Which currencies can I invoice in?** USD and EUR, and other currencies where supported for your business.
- **Can customers download the invoice?** Yes. Every hosted invoice page offers a PDF download, so customers can keep it for their records.
- **Where do invoice payments go?** Into your Easner Business balance, reconciled alongside your other payments in one ledger.

### Payroll

- **Who can I pay with Easner Payroll?** Employees and contractors in 80+ countries, paid from your Easner Business balance.
- **How do people choose how they get paid?** Each person connects to your payroll in the Easner app and chooses where they're paid – an EASETAG, a bank account or mobile money – so you don't collect payment details by hand.
- **How do approvals work?** Each payday is reviewed and approved before any money moves. Maker-checker approvals mean the person who drafts a run isn't the only one who signs it off.
- **Do people get pay stubs?** Yes. A pay stub is generated for every payment, with pay items and net pay, and people can download it from the Easner app.
- **Can I run off-cycle payments and bonuses?** Yes. Add an off-cycle payment, such as a bonus, alongside your regular paydays, with the same approvals and records.
- **Where do payroll payments show up for finance?** Payroll settles alongside your other payouts, invoices and card activity in Easner Business, so finance reconciles in one place.

### Stablecoin

- **Can I accept stablecoins in person?** Yes. Terminal and QR Pay let customers pay at your counter with stablecoins, where enabled, and every payment posts to your Easner Business ledger.

### Cards

- **When will Easner cards be available?** Cards are rolling out in phases. They appear in Easner Business and the Easner app once they're available for your account and you're approved.
- **Are there personal and business cards?** Yes. Corporate cards are issued from Easner Business; personal cards come with Easner Personal Banking in the Easner app, when available.
- **Can I get virtual and physical cards?** Both. Virtual cards are ready to use online, and physical cards are shipped to the cardholder, when available.
- **What spending controls are there?** Monthly limits, merchant rules and team policies for each cardholder, plus the option to freeze or retire a card from the dashboard.
- **Where do card purchases show up?** Alongside your payouts, collections and account activity in Easner Business, so finance reconciles everything in one place.
- **Who issues Easner cards?** Card products are issued by a third-party issuer and are subject to approval. Easner is a financial technology company, not a bank.

### Developers

- **How do I get access to the Easner API?** Talk to our team. API credentials and sandbox access are provided during commercial onboarding.
- **What can I build with the API?** Customer verification, multi-currency accounts and pay-in details, stablecoin deposit addresses, payout quotes and cross-border payouts, all with webhooks for every status change.
- **Is there a sandbox?** Yes. Test keys and a sandbox let you run verification, pay-in, payout and webhook flows before you go live.
- **How are webhooks secured?** Every webhook payload is signed, so your backend can verify it came from Easner before acting on it.
- **Do my customers need a crypto wallet?** No. Settlement runs on stablecoin rails behind the API; your customers see balances and payments in regular currencies.
- **How is the API priced?** Pricing depends on your use case and volumes. Contact our team for commercial terms.

### Easner for Partners

- **What is Easner for Partners?** A commercial partner programme with two models: the Agency Model, a full branded deployment on Easner infrastructure, and the Developer Model, API access without a full branded deployment.
- **What does Easner run, and what do I run?** Easner runs the infrastructure, verification, screening, payout connections and ongoing operational support. You run the brand and the relationship with your customers.
- **Can the product carry my own brand?** Yes. Your customers use a product under your name, logo and colour, built on Easner infrastructure.
- **Who is the programme for?** Money transfer agents, OTC agents, and faith and nonprofit networks moving money across borders, among others.
- **How do I get started?** Talk to our team about your use case and corridors, complete business verification with Easner, configure your branded product, then go live with ongoing support.
- **How is the partner programme priced?** Commercial terms depend on your model, corridors and volumes. Contact our team to discuss them.
